wiki.title: Karen Hurd
wiki.extract: Karen Ruth Hurd (née Willa; born 1958) is an American nutritionist, writer, and Republican politician from Clark County, Wisconsin. She is a member of the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Wisconsin's 69th Assembly district since 2025; she previously represented the 68th Assembly district during the 2023–2024 term. She also previously served as a member of the village board of Fall Creek, Wisconsin.
